_meta.purpose: Youth population caps (under 18): technique-first, conservative intensity, appropriate volume ceiling.
derived_from: NSCA youth resistance training position statement

name: Youth (Under 18)
description: Technique development before heavy loading. Conservative intensity ceiling; full range of motion prioritised.
notes: Load progression should be conservative until technical proficiency is demonstrated. Max-effort testing not recommended. Frequency may be higher than adults if per-session volume stays moderate.

sources: NSCA position statement on youth resistance training
Lloyd et al. 2014 NSCA position statement update
Faigenbaum et al. 2009 youth resistance training guidelines
